sourceDocuments.title: Agricultural Waste Ash for Pavement Subgrade Stabilization
sourceDocuments.text: Expansive black cotton soils in northeastern Nigeria undergo severe swelling and shrinkage during alternating wet and dry seasons. Stabilization with pulverized locust bean waste ash and hydrated lime significantly increases the unconfined compressive strength and California Bearing Ratio.

sourceDocuments.title: Geotechnical Investigation of Highway Distress in Borno State
sourceDocuments.text: Road pavement failures along the Maiduguri-Bama highway corridor are exacerbated by poor subgrade drainage and inadequate sub-base compaction.
